lockslots-desc: Toggle slot selection mode, then left-click backpack storage slots to lock or unlock them
settings-restart: Save changes, then restart the game to apply them. Lists and dictionaries remain editable in xinvtweaksfork.json; slot locks can also be edited using Lock slots.
setting-ExtendChestUi-desc: Show the sorting, transfer and slot-lock controls beside inventory dialogs. Requires restart.
setting-EnablePriority-desc: Show the priority input and apply text/configured priority rules when sorting. Requires restart.
setting-PushPullWheel-desc: Transfer individual items with Shift and the mouse wheel. Requires restart.
setting-StrgClick-desc: Transfer matching stacks up to the clicked inventory slot with Ctrl-click. Requires restart.
setting-Blocks-desc: Find another matching stack after placing blocks. Requires restart.
setting-Stairs-desc: Enable stack replacement when placing stairs. Requires restart.
setting-Seeds-desc: Find another matching stack when planting seeds. Requires restart.
setting-Tools-desc: Switch to another suitable tool at the durability threshold. Requires restart.
setting-ToolSwitchDurability-desc: Remaining durability at which to switch tools. Zero uses the existing tool-depletion behavior. Requires restart.
setting-Delay-desc: Delay before checking for a replacement stack after placement. Requires restart.
setting-CrateSwitch-desc: Enable automatic stack switching when interacting with crates. Requires restart.
setting-GroundStorage-desc: Enable automatic stack switching for ground storage. Requires restart.
setting-Piles-desc: Enable automatic stack switching when interacting with item piles. Requires restart.
